description: Could not surface, via search alone, a single concrete ÚVO Vestník notice page carrying CPV 66100000 / 66172000 for a Slovak banking or payment-processing contract.

result.result_summary: Search engines return ÚVO section pages and CPV code lists rather than individual notice detail URLs; ÚVO notice pages appear poorly indexed. The one concrete financial-services tender observed (SWIFT Credit Bureau services, EXIMBANKA SR) surfaced only via the commercial aggregator verejnesutaze.sk.

why_it_matters: Confirms that keyword web search is not a viable discovery route for this cell — collection must go through the ÚVO/EVO on-site CPV search, the daily Vestník XML open data, or TED, not through a search engine.

description: The ÚVO root domain https://www.uvo.gov.sk/ appeared in results with the title 'Error'.

result.result_summary: Not fetched directly in this pass, so no verdict. Most likely a transient error page, a bot-defence response, or an indexing artefact; deep pages (vestnik-a-registre, vyhladavanie) index normally.

why_it_matters: The verification pass should treat a bad response on uvo.gov.sk as unverified rather than dead, and should retry with a browser-like user agent before flagging the backbone source.

description: No confirmed public search/listing endpoint for EKS (elektronické trhovisko) contract browsing was located.

result.result_summary: Only individual 'Detail zákazky' URLs (portal.eks.sk/SpravaZakaziek/Zakazky/Detail/<id>) and marketing pages were observed; the listing URL recorded for that candidate is inferred and explicitly flagged as unverified.

why_it_matters: Below-threshold banking/payments purchases could be systematically missed until the EKS listing/search entry point is established.

description: Slovak procurement search terms for ATM/POS hardware ('bankomat', 'platobný terminál') returned no procurement-platform hits in this pass.

result.result_summary: Queries combining IS EVO/EKS with 'platobný terminál' and 'bankomat' returned only platform documentation, with search-engine commentary explicitly noting those terms were absent from the indexed content.

why_it_matters: Hardware-side CPV codes (30144000, 30233300) may need on-portal CPV filtering plus a broader Slovak lexicon (samoobslužné zariadenie, snímač kariet, akceptácia platobných kariet, obsluha bankomatov, cash handling) rather than the obvious two terms.

description: Neither the English nor the Slovak query surfaced a concrete, citable TED notice for a Slovak banking-services contract under CPV 66110000/66172000 via general web search; the only banking-services CPV example returned was Slovenian, not Slovak.

result.result_summary: General web search engines index TED notice PDFs only sparsely; CPV+country retrieval must be done inside TED's own search/API, not via external search engines.

why_it_matters: Confirms the collection design must be API-first. It also means the volume of SK banking-sector notices cannot be estimated from this scouting pass and remains an open empirical question.

description: No EBRD or EIB procurement notice was found that names a Slovak bank or payment-infrastructure operator as beneficiary. EBRD Slovak examples found were energy/transport (SEPS substations, electric buses); EIB Slovak operations found were energy, urban and SME credit lines (Eximbanka).

result.result_summary: IFI activity in Slovakia is real but concentrated outside banking/payment infrastructure; the closest financial-sector link is intermediated lending via Eximbanka SR and EU co-financing lines.

why_it_matters: Tempers the cell rationale: IFI procurement is a thin channel for SK banking/payments. It should be monitored at low frequency, with the financial-intermediary angle (which banks on-lend IFI money) treated as the more valuable signal than IFI procurement notices themselves.

description: Council of Europe Development Bank (CEB), EIF and NIB procurement/beneficiary channels for Slovakia were not searched in this pass.

result.result_summary: Only EIB, EBRD and World Bank were covered among IFIs.

why_it_matters: CEB and EIF have Slovak exposure via social infrastructure and guarantee instruments intermediated by Slovak banks, so a residual IFI blind spot remains.

description: No page in this pass was fetched directly; all findings come from search-engine result summaries. ECEPP and the F&T Portal in particular are known to be JavaScript-heavy and may be bot-defended.

result.result_summary: All URLs are recorded as candidates with confidence scores, not as verified-live endpoints.

why_it_matters: A downstream deterministic liveness/robots pass is required before any of these are wired into a collector; a 403 from ECEPP should be read as bot defence, not as a dead source.

description: The EU/IFI layer is almost entirely English-only: EBRD, EIB, World Bank and the F&T Portal publish notices in English, and TED's Slovak interface exists but notice bodies for SK buyers are in Slovak with limited machine translation.

result.result_summary: Slovak-language search was productive only for TED/SIMAP/ÚVO-facing pages; no Slovak-language IFI procurement source exists.

why_it_matters: Keyword strategies must be bilingual and asymmetric: Slovak terms for TED notice bodies, English terms for IFI portals.

description: None of the SK oversight/remedy registers found (ÚVO námietky, správne delikty, PMÚ decisions, NKÚ audits) offers a sector/CPV filter that would isolate banking, payments or card-acceptance contracts.

result.result_summary: Searches combining remedy terms with banking terms (bankové služby, platobné karty) returned generic register landing pages, not sector-filtered result sets.

why_it_matters: Collection must be full-corpus harvest plus own keyword classification; a naive query-only approach will miss most banking/payments cases.

description: No PMÚ SR bid-rigging decision specifically covering banking or payment services was identified in this pass; the prominent recent cartel cases surfaced were in energy and EU-funded construction/IT.

result.result_summary: PMÚ enforcement news found related to energy sector cartel (fines over EUR 7.2m, 2023) and EU-funds bid rigging; no banking/payments case observed.

why_it_matters: Prevents over-claiming; the payments channel may still exist inside IT/software cases, so IT-sector decisions must be read for payment-infrastructure subject matter.

description: The Rada ÚVO (Council) appears to have been made transitional, handling appeals only against decisions issued up to 31 Dec 2022 and ceasing to exist thereafter; the current second-instance route was not conclusively established.

result.result_summary: ÚVO/secondary sources state the Council's temporary nature; no authoritative page confirming the successor appeal route was retrieved.

why_it_matters: Collection design must not assume the Council remains the live appeal channel; misrouted monitoring would silently miss post-2022 appeal decisions.

description: Only the ÚVO /dohlad page was fetched directly in this pass; all other URLs come from search results and were not individually fetched.

result.result_summary: URLs are recorded with confidence scores, not liveness claims; several ÚVO paths are http:// legacy CMS links that may redirect.

why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve legacy uvo.gov.sk paths (e.g. /dohlad/rada-uradu/referencie/prehlad-rozhodnuti) before they are treated as stable endpoints.

description: A Slovensko.Digital red-flag/procurement monitoring tool was hypothesised but not confirmed in this pass.

result.result_summary: The targeted query returned Transparency International Slovensko material only; no Slovensko.Digital procurement analytics product surfaced.

why_it_matters: Leaves a possible civic-tech analytics layer unmapped; should be re-queried with SK terms 'Slovensko.Digital', 'Otvorené zmluvy', 'Red flags index'.

description: znasichdani.sk — the Aliancia Fair-play / Vizuálny obchodný register project (launched 2011) that let users search which state contracts were won by companies linked to a given person — appears to be defunct. A direct fetch of https://znasichdani.sk/ failed with DNS resolution failure (ENOTFOUND), and secondary sources state the project was terminated in 2018.

result.result_summary: DNS did not resolve; corroborating reporting says the project ended in 2018. Named in the cell scope but not collectable as a live source. Not recorded as definitively dead on the fetch alone — the DNS failure plus independent reporting together support the conclusion.

why_it_matters: This was the cell's designated beneficial-ownership-to-contract linking tool. Its loss means person-to-supplier-to-contract linkage must be rebuilt from RPO/obchodný register joins (e.g. via Ekosystém.Slovensko.Digital or FinStat) rather than taken off the shelf. Historical snapshots may still exist in web archives.

description: No dedicated ÚVO open-data API host (e.g. an 'opendata.uvo.gov.sk' style endpoint) was confirmed in this pass. ÚVO bulletin data appears to be published *through* the national catalogue (data.gov.sk / data.slovensko.sk) rather than via a first-party ÚVO API. A tender for an 'Open API rozhranie pre portál OPENDATA' was itself found as a procurement notice on uvostat.sk, suggesting such an interface was procured at some point.

result.result_summary: Searched in sk and en; found catalogue-mediated distributions and third-party APIs, but no verified first-party ÚVO API base URL.

why_it_matters: Affects pipeline design: the collector should target catalogue distributions and CRZ exports rather than assume a first-party ÚVO REST API. Worth a dedicated follow-up check against uvo.gov.sk itself.

description: uvo.gov.sk returned an 'Error' page in a search result snippet during this pass, and no direct fetch of the main ÚVO site was completed here.

result.result_summary: Treated as a hypothesis only — the official portal is almost certainly live and either bot-defended or intermittently unavailable. Not recorded as dead.

why_it_matters: The official portal is the upstream of every source in this cell; its availability pattern determines whether the open-data layer must be the primary collection route.

description: OtvorenéZmluvy.sk current operational status could not be confirmed. Search results describe the portal and its ~300k contracts and a GitHub organisation exists, but no direct fetch was performed and no recent (2024-2026) evidence of active updating was found.

result.result_summary: Recorded as a candidate with low confidence and access_status 'unverified' rather than as live or dead.

why_it_matters: If dormant, its red-flag scoring layer would need to be reimplemented over CRZ rather than consumed; if live, it saves substantial work.

description: No Slovak open-data or civil-society product was found that is specific to banking, payments or financial-sector procurement. All discovered analytics layers are sector-agnostic and must be filtered by CPV code, buyer identity or supplier identity to isolate banking/payments relevance.

result.result_summary: Searched sk and en for procurement-analytics tooling; every hit is a general-purpose corpus or aggregator.

why_it_matters: Sector isolation is our own work, not something the ecosystem provides. Requires an explicit CPV shortlist (financial/insurance services, banking software, payment terminals, card personalisation, ATM/self-service, IT services) and a curated buyer list (NBS, Slovenská pošta, state banks and agencies) to be defined before collection.

description: Neither the Slovenská FinTech asociácia nor SAF exposed a scrapable, complete member list in search results; SBA's exact member roster page was also not directly surfaced (only the aggregate '23 members / >99% of the sector' statement on the About page).

result.result_summary: Association identities and URLs confirmed, but member rosters need direct on-site navigation or an email request to the secretariat (sekretariat@slovakfintech.sk).

why_it_matters: Vendor-side actor coverage for A2 stays incomplete until these rosters are captured; missing vendor names means missing tender award matches.

description: Searched in Slovak for a dedicated card/payments industry association (analogue of a national card association or ATM/POS operators' body) and found none; the space appears to be covered by SBA, the two fintech associations and ITAS.

result.result_summary: No Slovak card/payments-specific trade association identified.

why_it_matters: There is no single membership list that enumerates POS/ATM/acquiring vendors; that universe must be assembled from ITAS, fintech associations and tender award notices instead.

description: ORSR has no confirmed official public REST API; reporting points to a pilot Swagger at obcan.justice.sk and weekly SQL dumps at justice.gov.sk/sluzby/registre/otvorene-data. Neither was fetched or verified in this pass.

result.result_summary: Bulk access route for the commercial register is plausible but unverified.

why_it_matters: Actor-graph construction depends on IČO joins; if bulk access is unavailable, per-entity scraping raises cost and blocking risk.

description: The DORA 'register informácií' collects each financial entity's ICT third-party providers, but no evidence was found that NBS publishes entity-level contents.

result.result_summary: Only the framework/guidance page appears public.

why_it_matters: Would otherwise be the single best map of who supplies IT to Slovak banks; its likely confidentiality means vendor mapping must rely on tenders and association lists.

description: No Slovak trade outlet was found that systematically and specifically covers procurement of payment infrastructure by commercial banks (as opposed to state IT). Coverage of private-bank vendor selection is incidental and largely PR-driven.

result.result_summary: Searches in SK for bank core-system / payment-platform supplier contracts returned mostly procurement aggregators and general tech magazine items, not journalistic deal reporting.

why_it_matters: Private-sector (sector=both) payment/banking deals in SK will have to be reconstructed from PR wires, vendor press rooms and international trade press rather than from local journalism.

description: The Slovak term 'tender' collides with the commercial aggregator brand tender.sk and with verejnesutaze.sk listings, which dominate SERPs and crowd out journalism.

result.result_summary: Three of five SK queries returned mostly tender.sk / verejnesutaze.sk / TED pages instead of media articles.

why_it_matters: Media-cell collection must exclude aggregator domains or use site-scoped queries, otherwise recall on journalistic sources is very low.

description: The core business titles for this cell (Trend, Hospodárske noviny, Denník E, Forbes SK) are wholly or partly paywalled.

result.result_summary: Only headlines/ledes reliably reachable without subscription.

why_it_matters: Full-text signal extraction (named suppliers, contract values) will require paid subscriptions or human review; automated collection alone will under-report.

description: No page in this slice was fetched directly; all URLs come from search-result metadata or prior domain knowledge. None is claimed as verified live.

result.result_summary: Discovery performed via search only; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: Some section paths (e.g. itnews.sk, forbes.sk homepages) may redirect or have changed structure.

description: English-language reporting on Slovak banking/payments tenders is very thin; the Slovak Spectator and international fintech press cover it only sporadically.

result.result_summary: EN-oriented seed query returned no dedicated EN outlet for SK bank tender coverage.

why_it_matters: EN-only monitoring would miss nearly all of this cell's signal; SK-language collection is mandatory here.

description: No single consolidated, machine-readable 'pipeline of upcoming public IT tenders' register was found for Slovakia. The pipeline has to be reconstructed by joining MetaIS project records, MIRRI public-consultation notices and MF SR/ÚHP ex-ante appraisals.

result.result_summary: Searches in Slovak for a consolidated list of prepared informatization projects returned only per-project consultation notices, not an aggregate register.

why_it_matters: Collection design must be multi-source and join-based; a single-feed assumption would miss most pre-tender signals.

description: No public vendor-day / supplier-day agendas published by individual Slovak banks (SLSP, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB, 365.bank) were located in either language.

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced only career pages and general conferences; bank-hosted supplier events appear to be invitation-only and unpublished.

why_it_matters: One of the cell's hypothesised signal types (vendor days) is likely not observable via open web collection for commercial banks; the equivalent signal must be taken from third-party conferences and sponsor lists instead.

description: MetaIS project/ISVS detail pages were not fetched in this pass; the older host metais.vicepremier.gov.sk still appears in search indexes while the current portal is metais.slovensko.sk.

result.result_summary: Search results returned a legacy-host deep link; current-host reachability not tested here.

why_it_matters: Legacy links should be treated as moved (redirect/rewrite to the current host) rather than dead; a deterministic verification pass should resolve both hosts.

description: LinkedIn job postings and LinkedIn company pages for Slovak banks and state agencies were not assessed as a collectable source in this pass.

result.result_summary: Only the SBA LinkedIn company page appeared incidentally in results; no assessment of LinkedIn job-feed accessibility was made.

why_it_matters: LinkedIn carries many senior payments/vendor-management roles that never reach profesia.sk, but it is login-walled and ToS-restricted, so its status needs an explicit decision.

description: Local-language terminology for 'vendor day' / 'supplier day' in a banking context has no established Slovak equivalent; searches used English-in-Slovak forms only.

result.result_summary: No productive sk term identified beyond 'dodávateľský deň' (not attested in results).

why_it_matters: This term family should be treated as untested rather than exhausted; future passes should try 'stretnutie s dodávateľmi', 'trhová konzultácia', 'prípravné trhové konzultácie' (the last is the legally defined pre-tender market consultation term).

description: No official REST API for CRZ was found. Community requests for a CRZ API exist on platforma.slovensko.digital (thread 'Centrálny register zmlúv API'), and the only official machine-readable channel found is the dated ZIP/XML change-batch export plus the HTML search UI.

result.result_summary: Bulk XML export exists; no documented official query API. Third-party APIs (Slovensko.Digital Datahub) fill the gap but are commercial.

why_it_matters: Collection design must be crawl/bulk-parse based, with rate-limit compliance, not API-based; budget for parsing effort and for a possible paid aggregator dependency.

description: Slovak law removes exactly the contract types most relevant to this cell from full publication in some cases: sources describing §5a ods. 5 of Act 211/2000 state that for certain letters (incl. contracts on securities/financial instruments and contracts securing the provision of payment services) only information about the conclusion of the contract is published, not the contract text. Sources also state that since 31.3.2022 only NBS retains a full entity-level exemption.

result.result_summary: Payment-services and financial-instrument contracts may appear only as a bare notice of conclusion, without price or terms.

why_it_matters: Absence of a full contract in CRZ is not evidence of no deal; analysis must treat these as censored observations and fall back to invoice registers, ÚVO notices and institutional pages.

description: https://data.gov.sk/dataset/crz returned HTTP 302 to https://data.slovensko.sk/datasety/crz; the target rendered as an empty JS shell to a plain fetch, so the resource list, licence and update frequency could not be read.

result.result_summary: Dataset almost certainly live at the new national catalogue domain, but its distributions were not confirmed by me.

why_it_matters: The open-data catalogue migrated (data.gov.sk to data.slovensko.sk); any stored CRZ dataset URLs in the collection pipeline are likely stale and need re-resolution, and the page probably needs a JS-capable fetcher.

description: A targeted Slovak query combining 'spracovanie platobných kariet', 'platobný terminál' and 'POS terminál' against CRZ returned mostly generic CRZ landing/FAQ pages and bank T&C PDFs rather than contract hits, indicating the public web index does not reach deep into CRZ contract detail pages.

result.result_summary: General web search is a poor discovery channel for individual CRZ contracts; only a handful of contract detail URLs surfaced (e.g. /zmluva/8907711 'Zmluva o akceptácii platobných kariet', /zmluva/12680586 electronic banking services).

why_it_matters: Discovery must be done inside CRZ's own search or over the bulk export, not via search engines; otherwise coverage will be badly biased.

description: OtvorenéZmluvy.sk (TIS / Aliancia Fair-play) is described in secondary sources but I did not reach a live working portal at a confirmed URL during this pass; only the TIS announcement page and a science-media article about the project were found.

result.result_summary: Project documented; current live endpoint unconfirmed.

why_it_matters: Its enumerated list of ~130 non-CRZ registers would be the fastest way to close the municipal/long-tail coverage gap — worth a dedicated follow-up including web-archive lookup.

description: Searches combining 'prípravné trhové konzultácie' with 'platobné karty', 'platobný styk' and 'bankové služby' returned PTK index pages (NBS, MIRRI, UVO methodology) but no currently open payment/card-specific market consultation from the cell's buyers.

result.result_summary: PTK infrastructure exists and is well documented, but no live payments-topic PTK was visible at search time; the one confirmed payments-adjacent PTK (Štátna pokladnica, payment-system infrastructure modernisation) is marked completed with a March 2023 registration deadline.

why_it_matters: Confirms PTKs are a real early-warning channel for this cell but that they are episodic — monitoring must be continuous rather than point-in-time.

description: No dedicated Slovenská pošta procurement page for payment terminals or cash-in-transit (preprava hotovosti) was found; posta.sk stated no commercial public tenders were currently announced.

result.result_summary: Payment-hardware demand from the postal operator is not exposed as a standing page; it surfaces only as individual tenders on the ERANET board or in the ÚVO bulletin.

why_it_matters: Collection for this buyer must be event-driven on ERANET/ÚVO rather than page-driven.

description: ÚVO profile detail URLs appear in two path forms (/vyhladavanie/vyhladavanie-profilov/detail/<id> and /vyhladavanie-profilov/detail/<id>), some with legacy cHash query parameters, indicating a portal migration.

result.result_summary: URL scheme instability observed across search results; not fetched, so liveness of either form is unverified.

why_it_matters: Any buyer-profile watchlist keyed on hard-coded ÚVO URLs risks silent breakage; resolve IDs through the profile search or open data instead.

description: The mfsr.sk procurement profile page fetched as navigation skeleton only — the substantive listing did not render for the fetcher.

result.result_summary: Page is live but content likely loaded dynamically or behind a sub-path; recorded as unverified rather than dead.

why_it_matters: Static HTML scraping may return empty results for MF SR; a headless renderer is probably required.

description: Searched in Slovak for a national aggregator of municipal official noticeboards (úradná tabuľa) carrying výzvy na predkladanie ponúk. No single national electronic úradná tabuľa for all obce/mestá was found; disclosure is fragmented across each municipality's own CMS plus CRZ, EKS and the various commercial e-procurement platforms.

result.result_summary: Only per-municipality and per-VÚC noticeboards were identified (bratislava.sk, zilina.sk, nitra.sk, kosickazupa.sk, kosice-city.sk).

why_it_matters: Low-value contracts — the fastest-moving payments-acceptance segment — cannot be caught by one feed; the collector needs an enumerated per-entity watchlist of several hundred endpoints.

description: The DPMK / Mikroelektronika contract for 1,331 in-vehicle contactless readers (~EUR 1,492,064 incl. VAT) was reported in Slovak media/search summaries, but no primary ÚVO notice or CRZ contract URL for it was located within this run.

result.result_summary: Deal is attested only at second hand; the primary award document remains to be resolved.

why_it_matters: Illustrates that award-level facts must be re-sourced to CRZ/ÚVO before use; media summaries alone are not citable evidence.

description: The ÚVO/NASES open-data publication of the procurement bulletin is documented, but the current concrete dataset/API URL could not be pinned down — historical references point to open.slovensko.sk and data.gov.sk, both of which have since migrated to data.slovensko.sk.

result.result_summary: Capability confirmed, endpoint unconfirmed.

why_it_matters: Bulk XML ingestion would be far cheaper than scraping; a short follow-up to locate the live dataset would materially improve collection economics.

description: One search result rendered the uvo.gov.sk root as 'Error'. No conclusion is drawn: this is recorded as unverified, most likely transient or bot-defended, not as a dead source.

result.result_summary: Status unknown; deep links to uvo.gov.sk subpages resolved normally in results.

why_it_matters: ÚVO is the backbone source for this cell; a false 'dead' verdict would gut the collection plan.

description: Could not resolve the ÚVO profile detail IDs for EXIMBANKA SR and Slovak Investment Holding in this pass. NBS (8643) and SZRB (9586) were resolved; the ÚVO profile search is a JavaScript SPA that did not yield the other two IDs through search-engine results.

result.result_summary: Two of four target authorities lack a stable ÚVO profile ID.

why_it_matters: Without profile IDs the monitoring pipeline must fall back on name-string matching, which is fragile across diacritics and legal-name variants (EXIMBANKA SR / Exportno-importná banka Slovenskej republiky).

description: The e-procurement platform used by SZRB, Eximbanka and SIH was not established. NBS is confirmed on IS JOSEPHINE; szrb.sk names no platform and points only to its ÚVO profile, and one eTrhovisko (ezakazky.sk) item page appeared in an SZRB-context search without confirmation of the link.

result.result_summary: Only 1 of 4 authorities has a confirmed tendering platform.

why_it_matters: Tender documentation, deadlines and supplier Q&A live on the platform, not in the notice; not knowing the platform means only shallow notice-level coverage for three of four banks.

description: An English-language search for NBS notices on TED returned only generic TED documentation and commercial TED-reseller pages, no actual notice URLs. TED's own search is a JS application not indexed usefully by web search.

result.result_summary: TED coverage asserted structurally (SIH confirms EU OJ publication) but no specific notice URL captured.

why_it_matters: TED is the best structured/API channel for this cell; it must be exercised through its API rather than via web search, and that has not been validated here.

description: NBS holds an exemption from the Centrálny register zmlúv and publishes contracts/orders/invoices only on nbs.sk under Act 546/2010, whereas SZRB, Eximbanka and SIH appear in CRZ.

result.result_summary: No single register covers all four authorities' contracts.

why_it_matters: A CRZ-only pipeline would silently miss the single most interesting buyer in the cell (the central bank). Two separate collectors are required.

description: The English string 'Exim Bank' is heavily polluted: searches return Exim Bank Tanzania, Uganda, Bangladesh and Exim Bank Group. Similarly 'NBS' collides with UK/Serbian building societies and 'SIH' is a common acronym.

result.result_summary: English-only querying on these actor names is unreliable.

why_it_matters: Confirms the mandatory-local-language rule for this cell: queries must use 'EXIMBANKA SR', 'Exportno-importná banka Slovenskej republiky', 'Národná banka Slovenska', 'Slovenská záručná a rozvojová banka' and IČO numbers, not English acronyms.

description: Both NBS and Eximbanka run parallel URL schemes: nbs.sk/o-narodnej-banke/verejne-obstaravanie/... alongside legacy www.nbs.sk/sk/verejne-obstaravanie/...; eximbanka.sk serves both a query-string CMS (?page_id=) and WordPress /wp-content/ PDFs.

result.result_summary: Duplicate/legacy URL trees observed on two of four target sites.

why_it_matters: Collectors keyed on one tree may quietly go stale or double-count; canonicalisation rules are needed, and old bookmarks should not be assumed dead on a single 404.

description: Despite Slovak-language searching with the exact idiomatic phrases ('pre dodávateľov', 'výberové konanie dodávateľ', 'kódex dodávateľov', 'nákup a obstarávanie'), no dedicated public supplier/vendor page was located for Slovenská sporiteľňa, Tatra banka, ČSOB Slovensko, 365.bank/Poštová banka, Prima banka, UniCredit Bank CZ&SK, PSS or mBank SK.

result.result_summary: Only VÚB banka has a confirmed public procurement page (/ludia/nakup-obstaravanie.html). All other SK banks returned merchant-side, product or unrelated results.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's core premise: for eight of nine target banks there is no direct, crawlable sourcing channel, so the bypass route must lean on group portals, e-sourcing platforms, and indirect registries rather than bank websites.

description: The Slovak/English term 'portál' + 'dodávateľ'/'supplier' for Tatra banka is dominated by MERCHANT acquiring products: 'Obchodnícky portál TB', 'Portál na splátky TB', 'Merchant portal'. Similar noise appears for other banks where 'dodávateľ' refers to the customer's own suppliers (e.g. VÚB fraud-warning page 'Pozor na falošných dodávateľov').

result.result_summary: Supplier-portal queries return acquiring/merchant product pages, not procurement.

why_it_matters: Any automated keyword sweep must exclude 'obchodník', 'merchant', 'akceptácia kariet', 'splátky' and fraud-advisory pages, or precision collapses.

description: https://www.vub.sk/ludia/nakup-obstaravanie.html returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain automated fetch, while search-engine snippets confirm substantive procurement content on the page.

result.result_summary: Bot defence on vub.sk; content exists and is public in a browser. NOT recorded as dead.

why_it_matters: The single most valuable direct source in this cell requires a browser-grade collector; a naive HTTP pipeline would wrongly mark the cell's best source as unavailable.

description: No public supplier-registration URL was found for Erste Group Procurement, Raiffeisen Bank International, KBC or UniCredit despite English, German and Italian searching. Only Intesa Sanpaolo's Portale Fornitori has a confirmed public self-registration endpoint.

result.result_summary: 1 of 5 relevant banking groups exposes a publicly addressable supplier portal.

why_it_matters: For Erste/RBI/KBC/UniCredit the sourcing channel is likely invitation-only or behind an unadvertised Ariba/Coupa tenant, meaning tender visibility for SLSP, Tatra banka, ČSOB and UniCredit SK must come from indirect signals (contracts, references, personnel, vendor press releases), not portals.

description: For mBank Slovensko no Slovak-language procurement or supplier vocabulary surfaced at all; the entity operates as a branch of Polish mBank S.A. and any sourcing terminology would be Polish ('dostawcy', 'zakupy', 'przetarg'), which was not searched in this run.

result.result_summary: mBank SK supplier channel unmapped; no sk-language footprint.

why_it_matters: Language coverage for this actor is incomplete and must be closed with Polish-language search before mBank can be called a dead end.

description: No dedicated public supplier/tender portal was located for the large private retail banks in SK (Slovenská sporiteľňa, Tatra banka, ČSOB) using sk-language queries for 'portál pre dodávateľov', 'nákup', 'obstarávanie'.

result.result_summary: Only VÚB surfaced a 'Nákup a obstarávanie' page (and that returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch). Group-level tools (e.g. Erste/RBI/KBC central e-sourcing) were not identifiable from SK-domain search.

why_it_matters: The largest private banking buyers in Slovakia may source entirely through parent-group platforms, meaning their competitions are invisible to any SK platform scrape and require a different discovery route (group procurement sites, vendor-side references, contract registers).

description: 'Portál VO' / 'portalvo.sk' from the cell definition did not resolve to a distinct live commercial platform.

result.result_summary: Explicit domain-quoted search returned no such portal; nearest matches were ÚVO's own pages, voko.sk and obstaravania.egov.sk.

why_it_matters: The cell brief may carry a stale or mis-remembered platform name; downstream verification should not spend budget chasing it, and voko.sk/egov.sk should be treated as the likely intended referents.

description: No SK-hosted instance of international corporate e-sourcing suites (SAP Ariba, Coupa, Jaggaer, GEP) serving Slovak banks was found within this cell's searches.

result.result_summary: Searches for private-sector bank sourcing surfaced only domestic platforms plus generic definitions of e-aukcia/tender.

why_it_matters: If SK bank sourcing runs on Ariba-type suites, tender visibility depends on Ariba Discovery-style public postings — a whole source family currently uncovered.

description: ERANET client instances mostly gate their tender lists behind supplier registration.

result.result_summary: Instance URLs found repeatedly land on views/registration.html rather than an open list.

why_it_matters: Automated collection from ERANET instances may require registered accounts, changing the legal/ops profile of that route versus JOSEPHINE's open list.

description: Slovak-language searches for ATM servicing and cash-in-transit tenders (verejné obstarávanie servis bankomatov, preprava a spracovanie hotovosti) returned vendor marketing pages and generic procurement portals, but no individual ATM/CIT tender or award notice surfaced in general web results.

result.result_summary: General search engines do not index the deep contents of the ÚVO Vestník, EKS, JOSEPHINE or ERANET well enough to find individual payments-infrastructure notices; the notices must be reached by querying those systems directly with CPV and keyword filters.

why_it_matters: Confirms that a search-engine-only collection strategy would produce near-zero coverage for this cell; budget must go to in-portal querying and API access instead.

description: The largest ATM fleets, POS estates and card-personalisation volumes in Slovakia sit with private commercial banks (Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB) and acquirers (Global Payments Slovakia, Worldline, SKPAY), none of which are contracting authorities publishing in the Vestník.

result.result_summary: Searches for POS terminal supply and card personalisation returned only commercial product pages, not tenders. No public tender channel was found for these buyers.

why_it_matters: The commercially most valuable payments-infrastructure demand in SK is structurally invisible to A2 procurement monitoring; it must be tracked via a different workstream (vendor announcements, references, corporate registry, RFP rumours).

description: The seed query on payment gateway / instant payment integration contracts (zákazka platobná brána integrácia okamžité platby SEPA) yielded regulatory and association material (NBS, SBA) but no procurement notices and no settled Slovak tender wording for gateway integration.

result.result_summary: Found the regulatory driver and its deadlines, not the procurement artefacts.

why_it_matters: The glossary for gateway/instant-payment procurement in SK is unproven; keyword crawlers built on guessed terms (platobná brána, integrácia okamžitých platieb) risk silent misses until validated against real notice text.

description: One search result for the ÚVO root domain was titled 'Error', suggesting the portal intermittently serves error pages.

result.result_summary: Treated as an unverified hypothesis, not evidence the portal is down. No fetch was performed to confirm.

why_it_matters: A collector must tolerate transient failures on the single most important source rather than marking it dead; retry-with-backoff and alerting on sustained failure are required.

description: No Slovak independent ATM deployer (e.g. Euronet-type IAD) procurement or tender channel was identified within this cell's searches.

result.result_summary: Not searched to exhaustion; no evidence found either way.

why_it_matters: Independent ATM deployers are a distinct buyer class for ATM hardware and CIT services; their absence from the map is a known blind spot rather than a confirmed absence.

description: No NCR Atleos Slovak-market press release, country page or bank reference was found in either sk or en searching.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only global ATM-industry comparisons and corporate spin-off coverage; no Slovakia-specific NCR Atleos disclosure surfaced.

why_it_matters: NCR/Atleos hardware is widely deployed in Slovakia (largely via Printec as channel partner), so the deal disclosure likely sits with the local partner rather than the OEM — collection should target partners, not Atleos PR.

description: No Thales/Gemalto press release or reference naming a Slovak bank card-issuance customer was found.

result.result_summary: Only generic global product pages (EMV cards, D1 issuing platform) returned; no SK-specific customer disclosure.

why_it_matters: Card personalisation/issuance supply to Slovak banks remains undisclosed on the vendor side; this relationship will have to be inferred from bank card-back branding, NBS registers or tender records instead.

description: No Nexi Group press release specific to Slovakia or a Slovak bank was located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Nexi PR archive exists and is crawlable, but keyword searching produced no Slovakia hit.

why_it_matters: Suggests Nexi has no publicly announced Slovak bank acquiring partnership to date; the archive is still worth monitoring rather than treating as covered.

description: Asseco CE reference page returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetch.

result.result_summary: https://ce.asseco.com/referencie/ → 403 Forbidden; the same domain is well indexed and other paths appear in search results, so this is presumed bot-defence rather than a dead page. Recorded as unverified.

why_it_matters: The single most valuable reference list in this cell needs a browser-grade fetcher; a naive crawler would wrongly mark it dead.

description: Slovak banks systematically do not name their IT suppliers, and vendors often anonymise bank clients in case studies ('banka', 'bankový sektor').

result.result_summary: Documented by a Forbes SK / Asseco-clipped article; corroborated by DATALAN case studies referring to unnamed 'banka'.

why_it_matters: Vendor disclosure in SK is partially anonymised, so this cell's output frequently yields scope-without-buyer and must be triangulated against tender/award records from other cells.

description: No dedicated Slovak-language press room was found for Global Payments SK, Printec Slovakia, Euronet SK or Loomis SK.

result.result_summary: These local entities publish product/document pages but no discoverable SK press-release feed; announcements appear on group-level EN sites or via SK media wires.

why_it_matters: Collection design must poll group-level EN press rooms plus SK media wires (SITA, TOUCHIT BrandIT) rather than expecting local vendor press feeds.
